article_content: England's cricket selectors have included uncapped Kent wicketkeeper Sam Billings in their preliminary World Cup squad following Craig Kieswetter's extended injury absence. The 23-year-old received ICC approval for squad inclusion after medical reports confirmed Kieswetter's ongoing vision issues stemming from a facial injury sustained last season. Billings joins Jos Buttler and Jonny Bairstow as wicketkeeping options in the 30-player roster. Kieswetter publicly supported his replacement via social media, tweeting: 'Big congrats to @sambillings on the World Cup call-up - a massive talent destined for stardom.' The announcement coincided with ICC's release of 12 participating nations' squads, with Australia and Ireland yet to finalize their selections. Teams must reduce squads to 15 players by early January ahead of the February tournament. England plans to trim their group to 16 next week before their Australia tri-series warm-up matches. Scotland has named a 24-player preliminary squad under captain Preston Mommsen.

article_content: Singapore's GIC sovereign wealth fund has finalized a $210 million (3.3 trillion rupiah) investment for a 33% stake in Indonesia's Margautama Nusantara toll road operator. The deal, executed through GIC's Warrington Investment subsidiary on November 3, coincides with Metro Pacific Tollways Indonesia's (MPTI) parallel agreement to purchase a 10.3% share for 1 trillion rupiah. Proceeds from both transactions will address debt obligations from Margautama's 2022 acquisition of a 40% interest in the Jakarta-Cikampek Elevated toll road project. Regulatory approvals pending until November 9 could reduce current majority owner MPTC's stake from 71.5% to 50.9%. This follows parent company Metro Pacific Investment Corp's (MPIC) recent moves toward privatization, including First Pacific's 54.8 billion peso ($992 million) investment for a 36.6% stake. Anthoni Salim's family, holding 45.4% of First Pacific and a $7.5 billion fortune per Forbes Asia, continues expanding its infrastructure portfolio alongside interests in global consumer goods giant Indofood.

article_content: LONDON, England (CNN) — Blake Mycoskie launched TOMS Shoes in 2006 with a mission to sustainably provide footwear for underprivileged children. The California-based entrepreneur credits his success to 'reckless ambition' and shares key lessons from his journey. Here's how aspiring innovators can learn from his approach: 1. **Follow Your Passion**: Despite no prior footwear industry experience, Mycoskie immersed himself in shoe production and personally marketed early designs at Los Angeles hotspots. 'I approached this with the same reckless ambition I apply to everything,' he recalls. 2. **Build Strategic Partnerships**: Mycoskie emphasizes collaborating with existing companies to scale social impact. 'Why reinvent the wheel? Partner with organizations already excelling in their fields to expand giving models,' he advises. 3. **Adapt Your Strategy**: Initially considering traditional charity, Mycoskie pivoted to a business model for sustainable impact. 'A company ensures recurring support — you can't guarantee that with donations alone,' he explains. 4. **Recognize Market Realities**: After launching Reality Central following his appearance on 'The Amazing Race', Mycoskie closed the venture when facing competition from media giant Rupert Murdoch's enterprises. 'You must assess competitors realistically — sometimes retreating is strategic,' he states. 5. **Leverage Experience**: Four prior startups prepared Mycoskie for TOMS' rapid growth. 'Every failure trained me for this opportunity,' he reflects.
translated_content: लंडन, इंग्लंड (सीएनएन) — ब्लेक मायकोस्की यांनी २००६ मध्ये टॉम्स शूजची स्थापना केली, ज्याचा उद्देश गरजू मुलांना शाश्वत पद्धतीने पादत्राणे पुरवणे होता. कॅलिफोर्नियातील या उद्योजकाने आपल्या यशाचे श्रेय 'साहसी महत्वाकांक्षा'ला दिले आणि व्यवसायातील मुख्य धड्यांविषयी माहिती सांगितली. उद्योजक बनू इच्छिणाऱ्यांसाठी त्यांच्या अनुभवातील महत्त्वाचे मुद्दे: १. **आवडीचा मार्ग अनुसरा**: पादत्राणे उद्योगात अनुभव नसतानाही, मायकोस्की यांनी स्वतः बूट निर्मिती शिकून लॉस एंजेलिसमधील प्रसिद्ध ठिकाणी विक्री सुरू केली. 'मी हे जीवनातील प्रत्येक गोष्टीप्रमाणेच साहसी महत्वाकांक्षेने केले,' असे ते स्पष्ट करतात. २. **योग्य भागीदारी निवडा**: सामाजिक प्रभाव वाढवण्यासाठी मायकोस्की यांनी इतर कंपन्यांसोबत सहकार्यावर भर दिला. 'चाक पुन्हा शोधायची गरज नाही. आधीच उत्तम काम करणाऱ्या संस्थांबरोबर भागीदारी करा,' अशी त्यांची समजूत आहे. ३. **लवचिक रहा**: पारंपारिक देणगी संकल्पनेऐवजी, मायकोस्की यांनी शाश्वत उपाय म्हणून व्यवसाय मॉडेल स्वीकारला. 'व्यवसायामुळे नियमित मदत शक्य होते — फक्त दानावर अवलंबून राहिल्यास हे सुरू ठेवता येत नाही,' असे ते सांगतात. ४. **बाजाराची वास्तविकता ओळखा**: 'द अमेझिंग रेस' मधील सहभागानंतर सुरू केलेल्या 'रिऍलिटी सेंट्रल' चॅनेलला रूपर्ट मर्डॉक या मीडिया प्रबंधकाशी स्पर्धा करावी लागल्याने ते बंद करावे लागले. 'मोठ्या स्पर्धकांशी लढणे धोकादायक ठरू शकते — काही वेळा माघार घेणे हेच शहाणपणाचे असते,' असे त्यांचे मत आहे. ५. **अनुभवाचा फायदा घ्या**: टॉम्सच्या यशासाठी मायकोस्की यांना आधीच्या चार व्यवसाय उपक्रमांतील अनुभव उपयोगी पडला. 'प्रत्येक अपयशाने मला या यशासाठी तयार केले,' अशी त्यांची भूमिका आहे.
